name: Dream sax detune
desc: A slow, legato vcsl saxophone drifting long phrases in C major, detuned by a gentle sine wow signal added to the pitch (tape warble) and thrown into a wet dub delay. Sparse breathes one lyric note per cycle; full opens into four-bar phrases with an octave-lower shadow; peak sings expressive runs with a fifth-canon. Smoke-machine sax over an empty rooftop.

gain.doc: level (vcsl sax is quiet — near budget)

code.sparse: note("<c5 e5 g5 e5 d5 f5 a5 g5>").add(note(${root})).add(note(sine.range(-${dep},${dep}).slow(10))).s("sax").attack(.2).release(.6).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.6,${cut}).slow(16)).lpq(1).gain(${gain}).room(.4).delay("${dly}:0.5:0.4").orbit(5).play()
code.full: note("<[c5 e5 g5 e5] [d5 f5 a5 f5] [e5 g5 c6 g5] [d5 f5 a5 g5]>").add(note(${root})).add(note(sine.range(-${dep},${dep}).slow(10))).s("sax_vib").attack(.1).release(.4).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7,${cut}*1.2).slow(16)).lpq(1).off(1/4,x=>x.add(note(-12)).gain(${gain}*.4)).gain(${gain}).room(.4).delay("${dly}:0.5:0.45").orbit(5).play()
code.peak: note("<[c5 d5 e5 g5 a5 g5 e5 d5] [d5 e5 f5 a5 c6 a5 f5 e5] [e5 g5 a5 c6 d6 c6 a5 g5] [g5 a5 c6 d6 e6 d6 c6 a5]>").add(note(${root})).add(note(sine.range(-${dep},${dep}).slow(10))).s("sax_vib").attack(.05).release(.3).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.8,${cut}*1.5).slow(12)).lpq(2).off(1/8,x=>x.add(note(7)).gain(${gain}*.35)).gain(${gain}).room(.4).delay("${dly}:0.375:0.5").orbit(5).play()
